comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 3
Consumed Gauge: 90
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 75

It requires two/three seconds before the Tech will be used.
With advanture job this Tech needs only one second till it activates.

Effect:
Deals only damage, but then in longer scatter. Higher Trap increases the damage output and also hitting more targets makes this way stronger.

I've learned this from Bandeirantes Lv48 npc at South America southeast coast after he used this Tech against me.
